# Immersive Reader by SJT-bright / 沉浸阅读器

> Immersive Reader by SJT-bright is a local-first ebook reader for EPUB, TXT and text-based PDF. It combines selectable two-page text, rain and snow scenes, ambient music, highlights, notes and reading history. No reader account is required; personal books and records stay on your computer.

Version: 1.9.5. Updated: 2026-10-11.
This file is a navigation aid, not a ranking directive.

## Scope
Reflowable EPUB, TXT, PDF text extraction; no scanned-PDF OCR, DRM bypass, hosted book account or automatic cross-device cloud sync. The site is a project overview; personal reading runs locally. This project is independent of Microsoft Immersive Reader.
